breach.summary: UnitedHealth Group subsidiary Change Healthcare suffered a devastating ransomware attack affecting over 100 million healthcare records. The attack disrupted medical claims processing and pharmacy operations across the entire US healthcare system.

Aflac disclosed a massive data breach affecting 22.65 million customers and employees. Threat actors gained unauthorized access to personal, medical, and health insurance data including Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and driver's license numbers.
A catastrophic breach of National Public Data exposed personal information for nearly every US adult, including names, Social Security numbers, addresses, and dates of birth.
Frost Bank customers were targeted by ransomware gang claiming to have exfiltrated sensitive customer data including account information and personal details.
The zero-day vulnerability CVE-2024-4577 in Progress MOVEit Transfer was exploited for mass data exfiltration campaigns by the Clop ransomware gang affecting thousands of organizations.
T-Mobile disclosed unauthorized access to customer data through an API vulnerability that exposed personal information for approximately 37 million customers.
Video hosting platform Vimeo confirmed a data breach where threat actors accessed user and customer data through compromised credentials.
Figure Technologies, a blockchain lending platform, suffered a data breach affecting approximately 967,000 user records including wallet addresses and personal information.
FirstCare Health Plans exposed healthcare member data through an unsecured database accessible without authentication.
Facial recognition company Clearview AI suffered a security breach compromising law enforcement agency credentials and access tokens.

cve.summary: Cisco IOS XE software contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web management interface affecting network infrastructure worldwide.
JetBrains TeamCity CI/CD platform contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to take control of build systems.
SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 appliances contain path traversal and RCE vulnerabilities affecting remote workers.
Windows IKE contains a critical remote code execution vulnerability affecting VPN and encrypted communications.
Windows Shell contains a zero-click NTLM hash leak vulnerability exploited by APT28 in coordinated campaigns.
cPanel & WHM contains a critical authentication bypass vulnerability actively exploited by threat actors.
GitHub Enterprise Server is vulnerable to remote code execution allowing attackers to compromise source code repositories.
FortiClient Enterprise Management Server contains an improper access control vulnerability affecting endpoint security.
Apache OFBiz contains a Java deserialization remote code execution vulnerability affecting ERP systems.
Linux Kernel contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the netfilter subsystem affecting all major distributions.

threat.summary: Russian military intelligence APT28 is actively exploiting CVE-2026-32202 Windows Shell vulnerability in coordinated campaigns targeting NATO allies.
North Korean state-sponsored Lazarus Group has stolen cryptocurrency through targeted attacks on exchanges and blockchain platforms.
Scattered Spider specializes in sophisticated social engineering attacks to compromise Fortune 500 companies and financial institutions.
LockBit is the largest ransomware group by revenue, operating a Ransomware-as-a-Service platform with thousands of affiliates worldwide.
Clop ransomware gang exploited CVE-2024-4577 in MOVEit Transfer software affecting thousands of organizations globally.
BlackMatter emerged as successor to Darkside, responsible for the Colonial Pipeline attack and hundreds of critical infrastructure breaches.
FIN7 is responsible for an estimated $1+ billion USD in financial fraud and theft from banks and financial institutions.
Chinese state-sponsored APT41 blends cybercriminal and espionage operations targeting healthcare and telecommunications.
Wizard Spider operates and maintains the TrickBot banking malware platform, stealing credentials from financial institutions.
Hive0163 is deploying Slopoly backdoor malware in targeted attacks against healthcare and education sectors.
